qualified_declaration_statements.fep136_embeddedLaw_expectation:
theorem fep136_embeddedLaw_expectation
    (law : FiniteLaw State) (observable : State → ℝ) :
    ∫ state, observable state ∂FEP.NativeBlanket.embeddedLaw law =
      ∑ state, law state * observable state

qualified_declaration_statements.fep138_staticJoint_rectangle_factorizati:
theorem fep138_staticJoint_rectangle_factorization
    (model : StaticModel Internal Sensory Active External)
    (blanket : Blanket Sensory Active) (internal : Internal)
    (external : External) :
    FEP.NativeBlanket.embeddedLaw (staticJoint model)
        (FEP.NativeBlanket.blanketCoordinate ⁻¹' {blanket} ∩
          FEP.NativeBlanket.internalCoordinate ⁻¹' {internal} ∩
          FEP.NativeBlanket.externalCoordinate ⁻¹' {external}) =
      ENNReal.ofReal (model.blanketLaw blanket) *
        ENNReal.ofReal (model.internalGiven blanket internal) *
          ENNReal.ofReal (model.externalGiven blanket external)

rows.statement_review: The embedded static joint mass on the actual blanket/internal/external singleton rectangle equals blanket mass times the two conditional masses, all converted to ENNReal. This directly transports authored static product rows.
rows.assumptions_and_scope: The row itself is atomic rectangle factorization, not CondIndepFun. The foundation additionally proves complete joint=blanket marginal compProd product kernels, which139 uses; do not say only atomic evidence exists. Null blanket rows have0 joint mass and need not determine unique conditional versions.
rows.positive_witness_specification_unexecute: Reuse correlatedBlanketModel: two diagonal blanket/joint atoms have mass1/2, off-diagonal blanket atoms0.
rows.adverse_witness_specification_unexecuted: Without product conditional rows, a correlated internal/external row at positive blanket mass fails the factorization. Full-support blanket law is not required for the constructed static model.
rows.nearest_topic_distinction: 079 finite CMI characterization has full-support requirements for its general iff.138 proves the embedded structural factorization, and its paired finite zero-CMI statement is not used as a substitute for native conditional-distribution proof.

novelty_record.new_invariant: Every discrete blanket-internal-external singleton rectangle has the exact embedded blanket and conditional product mass.
novelty_record.carrier_delta: Transfers the authored finite blanket factorization into native measure evaluation before invoking any conditional-distribution theorem.

touching_relations.rationale: Native singleton-rectangle factorization is paired with the finite conditional-factorization characterization from which its embedded masses are constructed.

qualified_declaration_statements.fep140_condIndepFun_measurableImages:
theorem fep140_condIndepFun_measurableImages
    {InternalImage ExternalImage : Type*}
    [MeasurableSpace InternalImage] [MeasurableSpace ExternalImage]
    (model : StaticModel Internal Sensory Active External)
    (internalImage : Internal → InternalImage)
    (externalImage : External → ExternalImage)
    (internalMeasurable : Measurable internalImage)
    (externalMeasurable : Measurable externalImage) :
    CondIndepFun
      (MeasurableSpace.comap FEP.NativeBlanket.blanketCoordinate inferInstance)
      FEP.NativeBlanket.blanketCoordinate_measurable.comap_le
      (internalImage ∘ FEP.NativeBlanket.internalCoordinate)
      (externalImage ∘ FEP.NativeBlanket.externalCoordinate)
      (FEP.NativeBlanket.embeddedLaw (staticJoint model))

rows.statement_review: Measurable images of the endpoint coordinate maps preserve139 native CondIndepFun via Mathlib composition. Image types need not be finite, because measurable maps from the finite source are used.

Noninjective endpoint coarsening is allowed; coarsening/removing the conditioning coordinate is a different and generally false inference. This does not assert retained information, invertibility or causal sufficiency of the images.

rows.adverse_witness_specification_unexecuted: In correlatedBlanketModel, replacing blanket conditioning by a constant loses conditional separation and exposes the fair diagonal endpoint dependence.

maturity_record.assumption_review: All carriers are finite and discretely measurable and internal and external carriers are nonempty. The theorem is rowwise for one supplied current state; arbitrary mixtures over current-state uncertainty require additional hypotheses and are not claimed.

    (dynamics : Dynamics Internal Sensory Active External)
    (current : DynamicState Internal Sensory Active External) :
    CondIndepFun
      (MeasurableSpace.comap FEP.NativeBlanket.blanketCoordinate inferInstance)
      FEP.NativeBlanket.blanketCoordinate_measurable.comap_le
      FEP.NativeBlanket.internalCoordinate
      FEP.NativeBlanket.externalCoordinate
      (FEP.NativeBlanket.embeddedLaw
        (staticJoint (nextStaticModel dynamics current)))

rows.statement_review: For each supplied current state, nextStaticModel has authored factorized next-state rows and embeds into a native law with internal/external CondIndepFun given next blanket. This follows the genuine static theorem139.
rows.assumptions_and_scope: The conclusion is rowwise. A prior mixture over current states can create latent common-cause dependence between next endpoints even when every row factorizes. No closure for arbitrary uncertain-state prediction, invariant measure, repeated dynamics or physical intervention follows.

rows.adverse_witness_specification_unexecuted: Use two equally likely current states, constant next blanket, and deterministic next internal=external=current-state bit. Each row is product and natively CI, but mixture is a fair diagonal law and not CI given constant blanket.
